title: Integrated Filing - Governance
regulation: Regulation 13(3), Regulation 27(2), and applicable Regulation 30 provisions
timeline: Within 30 days from the end of the quarter
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Integrated Filing - Governance
filing_manner: Submit the prescribed integrated filing and supporting disclosures

title: Shareholding Pattern
timeline: Within 21 days from the end of the quarter
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Shareholding Pattern
filing_manner: Upload the prescribed shareholding pattern format

title: Integrated Filing - Financials
timeline: Within 45 days from each of the first three quarter ends and 60 days from the financial-year end
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Integrated Filing - Financials
filing_manner: Submit financial results with applicable review or audit report and disclosures

title: Reconciliation of Share Capital Audit Report
regulation: Reconciliation of share capital audit report
timeline: Within 30 days from the end of the quarter
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Reconciliation of Share Capital Audit Report
filing_manner: Upload the report in the prescribed filing tile

title: Related Party Transactions Disclosure
timeline: On the date of publication of standalone and consolidated financial results
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Integrated Filing - Financials
filing_manner: Include the disclosure as part of Integrated Filing - Financials

title: Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report
timeline: Along with the annual report
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Annual Report
filing_manner: Attach the BRSR with the annual report

title: Secretarial Compliance Report
timeline: Within 60 days of the financial-year end
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Secretarial Compliance Report
filing_manner: Upload the prescribed secretarial compliance report

title: Annual Financial Results with Auditor's Report
timeline: Within 60 days of the financial-year end
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Financial Results
filing_manner: Submit audited financial results with auditor's report

title: Annual Report
timeline: Not later than the commencement of dispatch to shareholders
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Annual Report
filing_manner: File the annual report when dispatch begins

title: Initial Disclosure Requirements for Large Entities
regulation: Initial disclosure requirements for large entities
timeline: Within 30 days from the beginning of the financial year
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Debt / Large Entity disclosures
filing_manner: Submit the initial disclosure in the prescribed format

title: Annual Disclosure Requirements for Large Entities
regulation: Annual disclosure requirements for large entities
timeline: Within 45 days of the financial-year end
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Debt / Large Entity disclosures
filing_manner: Submit the annual disclosure in the prescribed format

title: Annual Promoter Encumbrance Declaration
timeline: Within 7 working days from the end of each financial year
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Announcements
filing_manner: File with each stock exchange and the audit committee
applicability: Promoters with applicable encumbrance declaration obligation

title: Intimation of Appointment of Share Transfer Agent
timeline: Within 7 days of the agreement
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Announcements
filing_manner: File after executing the RTA agreement
applicability: Entities appointing or changing an RTA

title: Prior Intimation of Board Meeting
timeline: At least 2 working days in advance excluding the intimation and meeting dates
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Announcements / BM / CA
filing_manner: File the prescribed advance intimation
applicability: Entities holding an applicable board meeting

title: Disclosure of Events or Information
timeline: As soon as reasonably possible and within the applicable 30 minutes to 24 hours
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Announcements
filing_manner: File the event disclosure and retain evidence of timing
applicability: Entities with a Schedule III event or information

title: Voting Results
timeline: Within 2 working days of the conclusion of the meeting
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Voting Results
filing_manner: Submit voting results in the prescribed format

title: Functional Website Requirement
timeline: Maintain a functional website with required basic information
portal: Company website
filing_manner: Maintain and periodically review the statutory website content

title: Record Date Intimation
timeline: At least 3 working days' notice; 7 working days for covered schemes; maintain 5 working days between record dates
portal: NSE NEAPS > Compliance > Announcements / BM / CA
filing_manner: File advance notice stating the record-date purpose
applicability: Entities declaring a relevant corporate action

title: Disclosure of Acquisition or Disposal
timeline: Within 2 working days of the receipt of allotment or acquisition intimation
portal: Specified acquirer disclosure to stock exchanges and target company
filing_manner: Use the applicable prescribed SAST form

title: Promoter Encumbrance Disclosure
timeline: Within 7 working days of creation invocation or release of encumbrance
portal: Specified disclosure to stock exchanges and target company
filing_manner: Use the applicable prescribed SAST form
